chunks: They are only waiting for a single blast that will seize them, but they will go on contending.

key_terms.صَيْحَة: a loud cry or blast (of the angel Israfil or divine command)
key_terms.يَخِصِّمُونَ: they contend or argue (with each other or with God)

ai.seo_question: What happens to disbelievers when the single blast seizes them according to Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the abruptness of death (al-Sayhah) as a divine seizure that interrupts the disbelievers' futile arguments, emphasizing that their worldly disputes hold no weight before the Hereafter. It serves as a reminder that the moment of reckoning arrives unexpectedly, catching those engrossed in their own justifications unprepared for the reality of divine judgment.
